# wso2is_role (Resource)

Manages a role and the API scopes (permissions) that it grants. A role belongs either to the organization or to one application. An application can only have its own roles when it sets `associated_roles.allowed_audience = "APPLICATION"`. Assign users and groups to the role with `wso2is_role_assignment`. To import a role, use its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_api_resource" "orders" {
  name       = "Orders API"
  identifier = "https://api.example.com/orders"
  scopes = [
    { name = "orders:read", display_name = "Read orders" },
    { name = "orders:write", display_name = "Change orders" },
  ]
}

# Organization role.
resource "wso2is_role" "order_admins" {
  name        = "order-admins"
  permissions = ["orders:read", "orders:write"]
  depends_on  = [wso2is_api_resource.orders]
}

# Application role (the application uses the APPLICATION audience).
resource "wso2is_application" "orders_ui" {
  name = "Orders UI"
  associated_roles = {
    allowed_audience = "APPLICATION"
  }
  oidc = {
    grant_types   = ["authorization_code"]
    callback_urls = ["https://orders.example.com/callback"]
  }
}

resource "wso2is_application_authorized_api" "orders_ui" {
  application_id  = wso2is_application.orders_ui.id
  api_resource_id = wso2is_api_resource.orders.id
  scopes          = ["orders:read"]
}

resource "wso2is_role" "order_viewer" {
  name          = "viewer"
  audience_type = "application"
  audience_id   = wso2is_application.orders_ui.id
  permissions   = ["orders:read"]
  depends_on    = [wso2is_application_authorized_api.orders_ui]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, unique within its audience.

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Application ID for application roles. For organization roles it is computed (the organization ID). Changing it replaces the role.
- `audience_type` (String) `organization` (default) or `application`. Changing it replaces the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Scope names granted by the role. For application roles they must belong to APIs the application is authorized for.

### Read-Only

- `audience_name` (String) Name of the organization or application the role belongs to.
- `id` (String) Role ID.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the role is shared from a parent organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_role.order_admins <role_id>
```
